free_tier.stated: No hard file limit. Own help page: 'We technically do not have a file limit for projects; however, the larger a file is, the longer it will take to process. We recommend keeping your interior file below 1 GB.'

egress.terms: No public download path for the source file — Lulu hosts it for print production, not for retrieval.

tooling: Web; no API for file ingest.
chaining: Unbounded ingest but no retrieval path at all — this is the pure 'upload-open / read-gated' trap (rule 2). Counts for nothing as storage.
limits_note: no stated cap; PDF only for print interiors, EPUB/PDF for ebooks; retail partners reject >100 MB.
reliability_note: The uploaded file is not served back to you or anyone else — it exists only to be printed. Rule 4: a host that gives storage but not your bytes back is not storage.

evidence.proved: 'We technically do not have a file limit for projects... We recommend keeping your interior file below 1 GB'; 'If you are publishing an ebook in Global Distribution, online retailers will often reject files over 100 MB'
